# Transporeon: API for Carriers

- **Product:** Transporeon: API for Carriers (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** HTTP basic or OAuth 2.0 (Transporeon). Declared security schemes: basic, oauth2_prod, oauth2_test.
- **Access:** Carriers connected to Transporeon.
- **To call it you would need:** Transporeon carrier API credentials for xp.transporeon.com.
- **Documented servers:** `https://xp.transporeon.com/carrier_interface/openapi`, `https://xp.test.transporeon.com/carrier_interface/openapi`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/transporeon-carrier-interface-openapi-v1-swagger-json](https://xch.transporeon.com/carrier_interface/openapi/v1/swagger.json) (Transporeon OpenAPI for Carriers, version 1.68.0). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/27230308/API+for+Carriers, https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/27230672/Technical+Descriptions+CI.
